evidence_quotes.name_asked: Well, let me go ahead and check for that but may I know who I'm speaking with please.
evidence_quotes.name_used_only_once: Can I have your, can I have your email address, Jen? [using informal variant, never used again]
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Not present; rep moved directly to demographics (date, address, size) without asking about items of concern
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep confirms: 'I'm searching for an available person to do the walkthrough right now' and schedules the walkthrough for later; call ends with 'we'll get in touch with you very soon sir' regarding the virtual walkthrough appointment

top_strength: Rep efficiently gathered all necessary address and property details (4100 sq ft, 4 bedrooms, 1 story, both origin and destination info) to set up the virtual walkthrough and created the customer profile while holding the line.
coaching_note: On a 4100 sq ft move that routes to walkthrough, use the first few minutes to ask about the customer's concerns and deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before routing to the walkthrough scheduler — the Two Promises step happens before probing on the v4 card and still scores on walkthrough calls.
